text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: pd-REDW-canary-authz-503s. Canary rollout v2.7.1 -> authz service 503 spike. Error rate p5 increased ~10x over baseline. Alerting dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/r/alerts/5234567890

pagerduty-bot: Paging on-call rotation: matt (ack required) -> page created pd-XXXXXX. Escalation policy: 5m -> oncall-lead.

matt: acked. I'm on it, looking at canary hosts now.

sara: @matt acked here too. I see the canary pool is ~12% 503s in last 3m, stable pool is 0.5%.

matt: pulling authz logs. grep for 503 in last 1000 lines.

matt: logs show repeated errors from jwt-parse: "NullPointerException in TokenParser" across canary pods. Stack trace points to jwt-lib 3.1 introduced in v2.7.1.

sara: that matches the commit list — v2.7.1 included jwt-lib bump.

matt: running quick diff of env/flags between canary and stable. No config drift. Seems code path changed.

matt: canary pod list: authz-canary-5, authz-canary-6, authz-canary-7. repro attempt:`curl -v https://authz-canary-5.internal/validate -H 'Authorization: Bearer malformed'` -> 503, previous stable returns 401.

sara: confirmed. Malformed token should be 401/400, not 503. This is a regression.

matt: @pagerduty-bot please escalate to oncall-lead (kevin) — severity S2 if customer impact increases.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation triggered to kevin after ack by matt.

kevin: joining. saw the escalation. taking ownership. thanks @matt @sara. quick customer impact check?

support-lead: Observability: ~4% of auth requests across customers are failing in last 5m, primarily for endpoints that validate external tokens. 3 customer support tickets opened, no major outages reported yet.

kevin: ok. action plan: 1) halt canary traffic 2) roll canary back to v2.6.9 3) monitor metrics + reopen canary when fixed. Anyone object?

matt: no objections. I'll run the rollback.

sara: I'll update the status page: component "Authz" -> partial outage, add note about canary rollback.

matt: executing rollback command (internal):
```
# runbook snippet - rollback canary traffic
POST https://orchestrator.redwood.internal/api/v1/rollout
{
  "service": "authz",
  "target": "v2.6.9",
  "scope": "canary",
  "reason": "regression jwt-lib 3.1 -> 503s"
}
# auth via deploy-bot token
```

matt: rollback initiated. api returned 202, scaling canary down and diverting to stable.

incident-bot: Canary rollout paused by matt. Action: rollback to v2.6.9.

kevin: watch the key metrics: p50/p95 error-rate, 5xx count, and external token validation endpoints. I'll keep PD escalation window open.

sara: status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/5234567890 - short note, timestamped.

matt: post-rollback check: authz-canary pods terminated, traffic shifted. 503 rate dropped to baseline within 90s. p99 latency stable.

support-lead: support queue: closing the 3 tickets as "root cause identified, rollback initiated". Notifying affected customers via template B.

kevin: good. I'm going to keep monitoring for 30m. Matt — can you capture the canary pod logs and upload to the incident artifacts? Use the incident runbook link.

matt: done. logs uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/incidents/5234567890/logs.tar.gz. grep snippet included.

kevin: drafting postmortem draft and assigning to matt for root cause + fix plan (rollback + pin jwt-lib to 3.0.x). Will include timeline and customer impact.

matt: quick mitigation idea: add defensive check so malformed tokens return 400 instead of hitting the NPE path. But we'll do an emergency patch after postmortem.

sara: schedule: revert commit in repo, run CI with token-fuzz tests, then canary again behind stricter gate.

kevin: thanks everyone. I'll ack on PD to clear the alert once we see sustained stability.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by kevin. Escalation paused.

incident-bot: Alert update: 503 spike mitigated by rollback. Monitoring for 10m to confirm.

matt: last check, 5xx count back to baseline. I consider this resolved from rollout perspective.

kevin: I'll mark as "resolved" in PD after watch window. prepare postmortem and timeline. If anything flares, ping here. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident resolved (pd-XXXXXX). Thread will be archived.

support-lead: status page updated to "operational" for Authz component. Customers notified with followup in 45m.

kevin: handing off to matt for postmortem writeup. Closing shift.

matt: taking postmortem. uploading initial draft to https://docs.redwood.internal/incidents/5234567890-postmortem.md

kevin: thanks all :heart:
